incidents.title: Kantonale Server betroffen: «Heftiger, breit angelegter Angriff»: Seit Sonntag finden Cyberattacken auf die Baselbieter IT-Struktur statt
incidents.summary: Reported in the press as a cyberattack. Open the report for details.

incidents.title: German drone maker Quantum Systems targeted in cyberattack
incidents.summary: The company supplies drones used in support of Ukraine. The attack became known on 14 November.

incidents.title: Hospital Clínico de la Universidad de Chile confirma ciberataque: presenta "dificultades en procesos de atención y servicios"
incidents.target: Hospital Clínico de la Universidad de Chile
incidents.summary: Reported in the press as a cyberattack. Open the report for details.

incidents.title: University of Texas at Arlington: personal data stolen in cyberattack
incidents.summary: The university confirms data was stolen. The Qilin ransomware gang has claimed the attack.

incidents.title: Singapore's Agency for Integrated Care: staff data exposed
incidents.summary: Unauthorised access to care-planning systems, detected 10 November. Data of up to 4,064 employees exposed.

incidents.title: York University: personal data going back to 2007 exposed
incidents.summary: The university announced a cybersecurity incident. Data from online forms includes contact, health, academic and financial details.

incidents.title: CSCTelecom leak exposed 125 million SMS messages
incidents.summary: An open database leaked messages in near real time, including bank codes and password reset links. The company says the flaw is fixed.

incidents.title: Maersk confirms data breach as WhiteArmor demands $5 million
incidents.summary: Attackers entered a legacy system from an acquired company and took data. WhiteArmor threatens to publish about 100 GB.

incidents.title: Unauthorised access to ConnectWise ScreenConnect partner accounts
incidents.summary: Disclosed on 11 November. Third-party extensions are the suspected way in.

incidents.title: Chow Sang Sang: membership system accessed
incidents.summary: Names, phone numbers, emails and last four card digits exposed. The number of records is not disclosed.

incidents.title: Ransomware attack on Belarusian cloud firm disrupts businesses for days
incidents.summary: Parts of the cloud infrastructure were encrypted, taking down websites, email and virtual servers. The company says it found no sign that customer data was stolen.

incidents.title: BYOD group claims data theft from Toyota
incidents.summary: The group claims it took emails, names, addresses and phone numbers and reached kiosk devices. Not verified.

incidents.title: Cyberattack on the Election Commission of Malaysia's website
incidents.summary: Reported on 10 November. The commission is working with the communications regulator and the impact is under investigation.

incidents.title: Attack restricts most systems at Vanderbilt University
incidents.summary: The university had to restrict access to devices, systems and cloud services. A ransomware group claims it encrypted databases and stole personal data.

incidents.title: Nitori Holdings: up to 37.62 million records may have leaked
incidents.summary: The Japanese furniture chain announced the breach on 9 November.

incidents.title: SEGA: 2.2 million email addresses exposed at newsletter provider
incidents.summary: The breach happened at third-party provider ARARA and covers 11 newsletters tied to SEGA.

incidents.title: LockBit5 lists travel company Yatra
incidents.summary: Listed on a data breach forum on 8 November. Not confirmed by the company.

incidents.title: Casinos Austria: web shop and data accessed through a service provider
incidents.summary: Detected on 2 November and reported to customers on 7 November. The attackers came in through an external service provider.

incidents.title: Mercado Bitcoin: customer deposit addresses drained
incidents.summary: Reported in the first week of November. The loss was later traced at $48.6 million across 11 blockchains.

incidents.title: Florida Department of Education: financial aid site hacked
incidents.summary: Reported in the first week of November. Data of 4.9 million people may be exposed, including Social Security numbers.

incidents.title: DreamHost: intruder in File Manager platform for two months
incidents.summary: Reported in the first week of November. FTP and SFTP credentials and webmail sessions were stolen.

incidents.title: Chainalysis: credentials and live tokens exposed for all customers
incidents.summary: Reported in the first week of November. The company shut down key services after a multi-front intrusion.

incidents.title: Sensitive data exposed in attack on health centre in Graubünden
incidents.summary: The attack hit local storage systems. Patient care carried on as normal.

incidents.title: Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance: about 444,000 customer records exposed
incidents.summary: Detected 2 November and reported 6 November. Services were suspended for a time.

incidents.title: Attack disrupts the Santos Port Authority
incidents.summary: About 70% of file backups were recovered by 12 November. Port operations continued.

incidents.title: DigiCert: customer passports and driver's licences exposed after server move
incidents.summary: A system was left reachable online after a server migration. Customer notifications were reported on 5 November.

incidents.title: SMBC: 227,216 customer email addresses leaked through a provider
incidents.summary: The breach was at email distribution provider Arara. Disclosed on 5 November.

incidents.title: Caribbean Airlines: passenger data exposed through reservation provider
incidents.summary: A breach at reservation provider Amadeus exposed names, itineraries and contact details.

incidents.title: SOGO Hong Kong: data of about 820,000 members exposed
incidents.summary: Unauthorised access to the membership system, detected 5 November.

incidents.title: Norad: names and emails of several thousand applicants leaked after cyberattack
incidents.summary: The Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation said on 4 November that details of several thousand applicants had leaked.

incidents.title: Ransomware disables computers and Wi-Fi at Queens Public Library
incidents.summary: Reported on 4 November. Public computers, Wi-Fi and checkout machines were down.

incidents.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa: fraudulent transfers through a service provider's platform
incidents.summary: Announced on 4 November. Attackers used compromised accounts; press reports put the amount at about $133 million, which the bank has not confirmed.

incidents.title: NSW Health: dental scheme website attacked
incidents.summary: Detected 29 October and reported 4 November. About 4 GB of data was exposed.

incidents.title: Gnosis Pay: legacy card system breached
incidents.summary: Card numbers, wallet addresses and personal data were exposed. The company says funds were not affected.

incidents.title: French blood service EFS: cold-room controls changed in attack
incidents.summary: The attack came through a refrigeration equipment provider and changed settings at three sites. No blood products were lost.

incidents.title: Inna: breach affects 16 schools in Iceland
incidents.summary: Reported to Iceland's data protection authority on 3 November. Assessment and health data were exposed.

incidents.title: Singapore Airlines: about 65,000 booking records affected
incidents.summary: The data was exposed through a breach at reservation provider Amadeus.

incidents.title: MoneySmart: customer data accessed
incidents.summary: Detected 29 October and reported 3 November. Names, IDs, contact details and policy numbers were exposed.

incidents.title: Turning Stone casinos forced to cash only after cyberattack
incidents.summary: The attack hit network and communications on 2 November. Casinos and convenience stores could only take cash.

incidents.title: CB Cloud: delivery platform PickGo accessed
incidents.summary: Detected 1 November. 164,180 customer-name records and some smaller data sets were exposed.

incidents.title: Sabcobel: remote attack forces supermarket refrigeration units into defrost
incidents.summary: About 20 units were pushed into defrost mode on 2 November, affecting 40 Ahold Delhaize and 15 Carrefour stores.

incidents.title: Osaka city government hit through email distribution service
incidents.summary: The 2 November attack on the provider hit nearly 400 of its customers and let attackers send fraudulent emails.

incidents.title: Wiping scripts destroy cloud data at Russian host Beget
incidents.summary: Ran on 1–2 November. Cloud data and virtual server backups were lost, the company says.

incidents.title: Attacker claims 30 GB stolen from Parle Agro
incidents.summary: Claim posted on a dark web forum on 1 November. Not verified.

incidents.title: Qilin lists Shibata Co. Ltd
incidents.summary: Leak-site listing on 1 November. Not confirmed by the company.

incidents.title: Interlock lists Assiniboine Dental Group
incidents.summary: Leak-site listing on 1 November. Not confirmed by the clinic.
